raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 is the only delivery with source_tz 'UTC' (378 rows, matching the 378-row batch). The silver step ignores source_tz, so those timestamps are stored as UTC while the other batches are Chicago local time. The 99 rows at 00:00-06:00 UTC on 2026-01-19 are 18:00-24:00 Chicago time on 2026-01-18, and the silver table then dates them 2026-01-19.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(local_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') s;"}}
